confidence_notes: Food and coffee estimates use aggregated Phnom Penh price data near the July 2026 window. Alcohol varies by venue; the cocktail and wine-glass anchors use a beer-relative estimate, with wine less certain. Accommodation anchors are broad model estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Phnom Penh-specific price data; accommodation reflects the broad range typical of a lower-cost Southeast Asian capital.
